The following events took place in '''3629''' '''[['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]]'''.<ref name="TOR Dates Forums"></ref>

==Events==
*A [[War on Iokath|planetary war]] is fought on [[Iokath]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Eternal Alliance, and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], during which [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] dies.<ref name="TOR:SoI" /> [[Darth Vowrawn]] subsequently takes the Sith throne as "Emperor Vowrawn".<ref name="TOR:ATAtC" />
*[[Theron Shan]] temporarily defects from the [[Eternal Alliance]] to spy on the [[Order of Zildrog]].<ref name="TOR:CoU">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|Crisis on Umbara}}</ref><ref name="TOR:TNC">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|The Nathema Conspiracy}}</ref>
